intent: IMPLEMENT SlidingWindowAssembler so the frozen test passes; Java 17, Spring Boot 3, non-blocking, no cross-context domain imports, no hardcoded config values. Spec: Telemetry Sequencing & Windowing domain (single device, not thread-safe). Constructor SlidingWindowAssembler(Duration size, Duration slide) with size >= slide > 0. List<TelemetryWindowClosedEvent> add(TelemetrySampleEvent orderedSample): windows start at epoch multiples of slide and span [start, start+size); a window closes (and is returned, ascending windowStart) when a sample with tDevice >= windowEnd is added; the sample belongs to every window containing its tDevice. List<TelemetryWindowClosedEvent> flush() closes all open non-empty windows. Empty windows are never emitted. Size/slide come from configuration, never hardcoded.
